part.text:
The Bureau of Transportation Statistics (BTS) publishes Air Carrier On-Time Performance data through their **Data Warehouse** at [https://www.bts.gov/data-warehouse](https://www.bts.gov/data-warehouse). For July 2025, the data would likely be available in the "Air Carrier On-Time Performance" dataset, which includes metrics like average departure delay and percentage of delayed flights.

### Steps to Find the Data:
1. Visit [https://www.bts.gov/data-warehouse](https://www.bts.gov/data-warehouse).
2. Search for the dataset **"Air Carrier On-Time Performance"**.
3. Filter results for the month of **July 2025**.
4. Download the CSV file or use the API (if available) to extract the required metrics for the specified carriers.

If the data is not yet published, the BTS typically releases data 3–4 months after the period, so July 2025 data may appear in late 2025 or early 2026. Let me know if you'd like help automating the download or analysis once the data is available!
